note: The named starting layouts of the battle HUD's six boxes, in the 480x270 stage layout (the numbers of src/data/hud.json). The 640x360 HUD is src/data/hud-640.json, made by scripts/stage-640.mjs; a preset is only what the editor compares a box with. Moved out of src/battlestage/hudpresets.ts by the fix round 1 of M3 (pass line 12: no look constant outside stage data).

timeline-bottom3.name: Timeline + bottom three
timeline-bottom3.about: The final side-view design: the turn timeline on top, the party table, the menu and the enemy box in ONE band along the bottom (framed as a single window with dividers).

ff-strip.name: Final Fantasy strip
ff-strip.about: Enemies on the left of the bottom band and the party on the right, the way the classic Final Fantasy battle screens read.

action-left.name: Action, menu on the left
action-left.about: The menu moves to the far left of the bottom band, the party table sits in the middle, and the timeline hugs the top left.

ps4-panels.name: Phantasy Star IV panels
ps4-panels.about: A wide party panel along the bottom with the menu floating in the lane between the two sides, like the old panel layout (kept for comparison).
